subject: ClearCart pilot: performance recap + advocacy ask
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearcart.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ClearCart pilot: performance recap + advocacy ask

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for running the two-week pilot with Redwood. Quick recap of the headline outcomes we tracked vs. your baseline:

- Average 95th-percentile response latency: 320ms (baseline: 620ms) — ~48% improvement
- Per-request token cost: $0.008 (baseline $0.035) — ~77% reduction with batching + prefix caching
- Intent classification F1 on your evaluation set: 0.92 (baseline 0.86)
- Throughput: sustained 180 qps on a single Dedicated pool during the high-load window

I've attached a short pilot_report_summary.pdf that includes the dataset slice, evaluation prompts, and the inference config we used. We also surfaced a couple of operational recommendations (KV cache TTLs and a 250-token warmup) that we can implement right away.

Would ClearCart be willing to do two small advocacy things that help our joint go-to-market?

1) A 2–3 sentence quote we can use in a case blurb and on our site (a one-liner about business impact is perfect).
2) A 20-minute call next week to record a brief testimonial or confirm attribution and logo usage.

Proposed slots (PDT): Tue 7/25 10:00–10:20, Wed 7/26 13:00–13:20, Thu 7/27 09:30–09:50. If none of these work, tell me a couple windows and we'll adjust.

Links: HubSpot deal DC-9842 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/clearcart) and the Drive folder with the report (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-pilot-evidence).

Would appreciate a quick yes/no and any preferences on attribution.

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0189

Attachments:
- ClearCart_pilot_report_summary.pdf (PDF)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearcart.com>

Hi Avery,

Really pleased with the results — the latency and cost numbers are especially compelling. Thanks for making the pilot straightforward.

We can definitely provide a short quote. Draft below — feel free to edit for tone:

"Redwood's platform cut our inference latency in half while reducing per-request costs dramatically, letting us scale conversational flows without ballooning spend."

I'm happy to join a 20-minute call next week to record a short testimonial and confirm logo usage. I can do Wed 7/26 at 13:00 PDT (that slot works). Please send a calendar invite.

Attaching our internal pilot_feedback.docx with a couple of notes for your team.

Best,

Liam O'Connor
